title: Ticket v1 Schema
description: Validates ticket-NNN.json files against the current little-mester ticketing engine schema per SCHEMA.md and DECISIONS field semantics (D.1-D.4, E, C.4). type is a top-level enum with 6 values, NOT a label set (per D.2 resolution). priority is the primary triage signal (per H decision). labels use prefix/value format with scope/severity predefined sets plus user/* free-form. Every ticket requires at least one acceptance criterion and a complete test ledger per DECISIONS C.4 and architecture DECISIONS J.

number.description: Auto-incremented unique ticket identifier. Never recycled when tickets are deleted.

area.description: Human grouping domain for the ticket. Set on creation and not changed after (if domain changes, create new ticket in correct area per DECISIONS D.1).

type.description: Kind of work. spike=research only (no code), feature=new functionality, bug=defect fix, improvement=non-functional enhancement, doc=documentation-only, infra=infrastructure changes. Per DECISIONS D.2.

status.description: Lifecycle state (DECISIONS D.3). Valid transitions: draft→active, active→resolved, resolved→draft, any→archived, draft↔active. archived has NO outgoing transitions.

title.description: One-line human-readable summary of the ticket objective.

objective.description: Detailed objective in present/future tense. Optional when creating a spike or initial draft.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last modification. Updated on every field change including status transitions.

priority.description: Primary triage signal for sorting and board views (DECISIONS H). Different from severity label: priority controls machine-readable sort order; severity/critical label composes with other labels in multi-criteria queries.

acceptance_criteria.description: Required definition of done. Each criterion carries its own verification status; the ticket-level test ledger records the paper trail. Per DECISIONS C.4 and architecture DECISIONS J.

id.description: Stable short id, unique per ticket. The engine auto-assigns A1, A2, … when omitted on input.

text.description: What must be true for this criterion to be met.

status.description: Verification state. pending=nothing verified, in-progress=implementation underway, test-needed=implemented but test still to write, test-created=test exists but not confirmed passing, passing=verified (evidence required), waived=no test needed/possible (note required).

evidence.description: Test path/case, command + result, or observed artifact. Required when status is 'passing'.

note.description: Why no test is needed or possible. Required when status is 'waived'.

tests.description: Required test paper trail. Arrays may be empty. On update the engine merges arrays rather than replacing them, so a later edit cannot erase the trail.

needed.description: Tests that still need to be written.

cases.description: Named cases covered, including manual observations.

labels.description: Cross-cutting categorization tags in prefix/value format. Valid prefixes with validation: scope (agent,engine,infra,docs,tests,security,performance), severity (trivial,minor,major,critical). All other values must start with 'user/' — validated only for prefix match, stored verbatim.

dependencies.description: Other ticket numbers this one depends on (resolved before this can progress to active).

blocked_by.description: Inverse of dependencies — tickets that block this one. Auto-generated by engine.

parent.description: Epic number this ticket belongs to, or null if it is not a child of any epic.

is_epic.description: Auto-set when created as epic. Marks the ticket as a grouping ticket with its own lifecycle and composite status from children (auto-computed on read, NOT persisted to file).

estimate.description: Effort estimate in hours or story points.

estimated_model.description: Which local model was used when the estimate was made. Records estimator context — different from suggested_model which is a recommendation based on area history.

suggested_model.description: Model recommended for this work type based on historical models_used[] data from other tickets in the same area. Auto-computed, overridable at creation. Per DECISIONS E.

estimated_models.description: Projected model split for complex tickets — each object represents a subtask with its suggested model. Set during estimation phase (post-spike). Per DECISIONS E.

thinking_time_seconds.description: How long the model was THINKING (not idle).

idle_time_seconds.description: Time waiting for input/prompts (tracked separately from thinking time).

cost_estimate_usd.description: Estimated cost based on token usage.

models_used.description: Per-model usage statistics from actual work done on this ticket. Automatically populated by opencode at session end — user does NOT fill in. See DECISIONS E.

comments.description: Timestamped notes/ comments on the ticket.

attachments.description: File paths linked to the ticket.

spans.description: Date range tracking for the ticket, or null if no span is specified.

assigned_to.description: Who is responsible (user or agent identifier). Free-form — not a lookup against a user directory.

type.description: Relationship type (blocks, blocked-by, relates-to, duplicates, etc.)

links.description: Typed relationships to other tickets. Per DECISIONS D.3.

subtickets.description: Subticket tree for hierarchical decomposition. Each subticket is a lightweight child entry.

notes.description: Free-form notes on the ticket. Distinct from comments which are timestamped with author.

dependencies.priority: labels must include priority-equivalent if priority is set but no severity label exists; however the engine allows both independently per DECISIONS H decision
dependencies.estimated_models: only meaningful when estimate is also set
